integrationsCatalog.developerDescription: Tools for custom development and publishing workflows outside the external services catalog.

guide.title: How the AI reads your brief
guide.intro: These four values go straight into the AI's instructions — first when it picks a topic, then when it writes the article. The more specific they are, the less generic the output.

focus.usedIn: Topic pick · Article writing · Comment insights
focus.description: Sets what gets written about and from which angle. It holds both the topic selection and the tone of the whole article together.
focus.good: objective gaming journalism, emphasis on the technical side of Unreal Engine and player freedom
focus.empty: The AI falls back to "general topics" and writes anything loosely related to the site.

audience.usedIn: Topic pick · Article writing · Comment insights
audience.description: Drives vocabulary, sentence length and how much the AI explains. It is the difference between "explain from scratch" and "skip the basics".
audience.good: game developers who know Unreal but don't work in it daily
audience.empty: The AI falls back to "wide audience" and explains things your readers already know.

language.description: The language new articles are written in.
language.warning: Keep the other three fields in the same language. If you don't, the AI writes the whole article in the language of those inputs instead of this choice.

keywords.usedIn: Topic pick · Article writing · The site meta keywords
keywords.description: They pull topic selection toward the areas you want to cover. The AI then works them into the text naturally, not by force.
keywords.good: 5–15 terms that genuinely describe your subject
keywords.bad: fifty generic words piled up for SEO
keywords.empty: Topics come from focus and audience alone.
keywords.note: These are not SEO tags to stuff. With Search Console connected, real search queries can raise a topic's priority, but they never override focus or audience.

preview.title: This is what the AI sees
preview.hint: A live preview of what you have filled in right now. Greyed values are the fallbacks the AI substitutes for an empty field.
